notes: Fixed two causes of runs that moved nothing, or moved the wrong thing, for some players. First: if you'd last visited the Shared/Account Bank tab, the plugin could mistake it for your character bank and drop items there instead — it now refuses to ever target the account bank, and switches you to the character bank tab itself before a run starts. Second: on displays running Windows scaling other than 100% (very common on laptops and 4K monitors), the real-cursor drag could land at the wrong physical point on screen, sometimes off it entirely, because of a DPI mismatch between the plugin's input calls and the game's own coordinates — that mismatch is now corrected for every real-cursor call, including calibration.
